title: One design system, six templates, one dominant layout.
text: 34 live pages. The writing template holds 29 of them (28 articles and the index) in 2 layout variants; home, portfolio, talks, certifications and privacy are one page each.

title: Build the article once and most of the site is done.
text: 28 articles share the hero article, rail, related row list and author box; 25 carry framed figures, 19 pages a YouTube embed and 18 a dark code block.

title: Mostly new blocks, because parity is the target.
text: 23 of 34 catalog entries are new; the rest extend a boilerplate or Block Collection block with a variant class. Nothing renders as-is under pixel parity except section metadata.

title: The long tail is the article explainers.
text: 27 articles carry bespoke interactive explainers or labs (32 explainer and 30 lab instances); 26 pages load a per-article explainer.css. How they are built is the one blocking implementation question.

title: Little of the site is data-driven.
text: 14 features. The writing index is the only listing (1 page); the GA4 tag and the Cloudflare beacon run on 34 pages. Everything else is chrome (theme control, menu) or client-only compute that ships with its block.

title: Two paragraph patterns are invisible to the block map.
text: Facts paragraphs on 28 articles and Watch this part chapters on 17 are classed paragraphs, which DA authors cannot reproduce; the catalog lists facts and chapters as blocks even though the parser counts them as default content.

title: No redirects needed if every page keeps its folder URL.
text: Every page is a folder URL with a trailing slash; 0 delivered paths change beyond the trailing-slash rule. Authoring each page as an index document keeps every URL, so the redirect sheet stays empty.

title: Cloudflare rewrites content at the edge.
text: Email obfuscation turned email-like strings on 3 articles into /cdn-cgi links, and the zone injects the analytics beacon on 34 pages; both follow the site to EDS unless the zone settings change.

title: Decisions before launch.
text: 5 of 15 open questions block launch (URL format, image hosting, CDN routing, parity target, explainer build); each ships a default, and two already carry the owner's recorded answer.
